audit.input_rationale: Inputs are the whole task worktree (hashed, nothing excluded), the Go launcher at /usr/local/go, and the Go module cache at /home/user/go/pkg/mod, which holds the go1.24.0 toolchain that GOTOOLCHAIN=auto selects from go.mod and every resolved module. GOCACHE points at a fresh empty directory for each run, so no earlier build output is reused. The Make targets run go test with -count=1, scripts/go-test-require-tests.sh (bash, tee, mktemp, grep, awk), and env through VALIDATION_CHILD_ENV. The database is a disposable owned fixture that this helper prepares and removes; its server is the backend probe. HOME is inventoried by fingerprint and the targets read no HOME configuration. No output directory is excluded.
audit.git_rationale: Treated as Git-metadata dependent by default; these records are fresh backend executions, which the helper never reuses.
